summary: Verified Summer beach-ball heist randomization enhancement. Forced 15 strikes via ff:ball-heist event with summer theme. Both entry sides observed (left+right); right entry correctly exits toward LEFT-bottom (xN≈-253, medallion cx≈470); left entry exits right (xN≈1090). Launch height (dip) varies per strike — captured y0 values 435, 371, 337, 375, 372 (all distinct). Bonk logo clone [data-testid=ball-heist-logo] appears; medallion visibility is restored after each strike. One console warning found (see issues).

ui_bugs.issue: React console warning every strike: 'Updating a style property during rerender when a conflicting property is set... Updating animation animationDirection'. The inline style sets both the shorthand `animation` and the longhand `animationDirection` on the same element, which React explicitly warns against because the order can produce inconsistent results.

action_items: Fix animation/animationDirection shorthand-longhand conflict in SummerBallHeist. Recommended: fold direction into the shorthand, e.g. `animation: phase === 1 || phase === 3 ? \`ffBallHeistSpin 0.7s linear infinite ${fromLeft ? 'normal' : 'reverse'}\` : (phase === 2 ? 'ffBallSettle 0.6s ease-out' : undefined)` and drop the separate `animationDirection` line. This will silence the React warning without changing behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: Mixing shorthand `animation` with longhand `animationDirection` in the same style object triggers React warning on every strike (30+ warnings observed in one test session).
New randomization logic itself is correct — side/dip are chosen at strike time inside setRun, and fromLeft/sx/exitX/animationDirection all derive from `run` state consistently within a strike.
seed_data_creation: None. Set localStorage keys ff_theme=summer, ff_theme_chosen=1, ff_theme_hint_seen=1 before load.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To force the ball heist quickly: set localStorage['ff_theme']='summer' + '1' flags, reload, then dispatch `ff:ball-heist` event. Reset window.__ffHeistCooldownUntil=0 and window.__ffFateBusy=false between forces. Phase 0 only lasts ~30ms — poll for [data-testid='ball-heist'] every 5ms in a loop to catch initial transform. Alternatively infer entry side from final translate X: xN≈-253 → right entry, xN≈1090 → left entry (based on 1920px viewport).
rca of the issue: React 18+ warns when inline `style` mixes CSS shorthand and longhand properties for the same property, because React iterates keys in object order and can't guarantee which wins. In seasonHeists.jsx the new right-side feature added `animationDirection: fromLeft ? undefined : 'reverse'` alongside the pre-existing `animation: ...` shorthand. Even when animationDirection is undefined, React's warning still fires. Reproduction: force any strike; warning appears once per re-render (phase changes trigger 3+ warnings per heist). Mitigation: include direction inside the shorthand string; remove the separate animationDirection key.
